notes.title: Our first Steam news post!
notes.content:
Greetings Agonians,

Another update for those curious and eager to be in the know about all the irons on the fire!

Our dev team has been hard at work getting the Linux server builds up and running, and while it's experimental at the moment, it's showing great promise and is something we're very excited to integrate into our launch!

Java8 builds are smooth once more, meaning that the server for this is running well, and we'll also be getting the client up and running within no time at all to prepare for regular patches and automated patching with new tools. 

We’re currently working on Steam integration, focusing on smooth game launches through the Steam client to improve how players start Darkfall: Rise of Agon. We're also working on Steam-to-client detection to ensure the handoff between Steam and our game launcher is reliable. 

We'll also be undergoing some website adjustments, just some housekeeping and sprucing up the site to modernize it.

That's all from us now, but stay tuned as we have more in the pipeline coming before you know it - we'd also like to encourage you guys to let us know anything you feel you'd like to see. We're always interested in new ideas and if there are any thoughts or suggestions you have, we would love to hear them!

Thanks for your patience and support!

Toxic Rain Studios
